title: Add Pluggable Regularization to Logistic Regression
prompt:
A logistic-regression model performs well on training data but poorly in production. Discuss how you would distinguish distribution shift from overfitting, then extend the supplied training code to support regularization.

Implement `L2Regularizer(lambda_param)` and complete the two missing integrations in `train_logistic`. The objective is mean binary cross-entropy plus `lambda_param * sum(coefficients ** 2)`; the model has no separate intercept. The training loop must also work with any object implementing `loss_penalty(coefficients)` and `gradiate_penalty(coefficients)`. Keep that supplied method spelling.

Return the fitted coefficients and the full-data objective after each epoch. Keep the provided batching and prediction behavior, include the final partial batch, and do not modify the inputs. The prediction helper labels a sample positive only when its probability is strictly greater than the threshold.
